GUEST_FROM_HERESY_RELIC_VOID_FRAGMENT.de: After obtaining this relic, gain 1 stack whenever you enter a Rest Site. Per stack: Projection of LOSTAVA starts each combat with 3 more HP. Gain 1 additional Strength and Dexterity while Gazed.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_RELIC_VOID_FRAGMENT.fl: Fragmented words point toward an endless void.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_RELIC_SEALED_GATE.desc: During this combat, each [gold]Energy[/gold] spent grants Projection of LOSTAVA 1 Max HP and heals it for 1 HP.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_RELIC_SEALED_GATE.flav: Behind the door, a page turns.
During this combat, each [gold]Energy[/gold] spent grants Projection of LOSTAVA 2 Max HP and heals it for 2 HP.
The door is open. The gaze never ceased.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_RELIC_SECRET_FEAST_CHA: The first card you play each combat is played one additional time when you first become [gold]Gazed[/gold].
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_RELIC_MOON_PHASE_INSTR: At the start of each combat, upgrade all [gold]Crescents[/gold] and [gold]Full Moons[/gold] in your hand.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_RELIC_MOON_DUST_NODULE: Every 3 [gold]Moon Phase[/gold] cards you play, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] for this combat.
GUEST_FROM_HERESY_RELIC_SHADOW_MISSILE_N: At the start of each combat, add 3 [gold]Shadow Missiles[/gold] to your hand.
